potion_of_healing.name: Potion of Healing
potion_of_healing.action: Bonus Action to drink, or Action to administer
potion_of_healing.description: You regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points when you drink this potion. Drinking a potion yourself is a Bonus Action; administering it to another creature is an Action.

potion_of_greater_healing.name: Potion of Greater Healing
potion_of_greater_healing.action: Bonus Action to drink, or Action to administer
potion_of_greater_healing.description: You regain 4d4 + 4 Hit Points when you drink this potion.

potion_of_superior_healing.name: Potion of Superior Healing
potion_of_superior_healing.action: Bonus Action to drink, or Action to administer
potion_of_superior_healing.description: You regain 8d4 + 8 Hit Points when you drink this potion.

spell_scroll.name: Spell Scroll
spell_scroll.description: A Spell Scroll bears the magical words of a single spell. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components.

bag_of_holding.name: Bag of Holding
bag_of_holding.description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag always weighs 15 pounds.

boots_of_elvenkind.name: Boots of Elvenkind
boots_of_elvenkind.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

cloak_of_elvenkind.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
cloak_of_elvenkind.description: While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

weapon_plus_1.name: Weapon, +1
weapon_plus_1.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

weapon_plus_2.name: Weapon, +2
weapon_plus_2.description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

armor_plus_1.name: Armor, +1
armor_plus_1.description: You have a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor.

wand_of_magic_missiles.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
wand_of_magic_missiles.description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the Magic Missile spell from it. Regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.
